entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor and I'm... I'm hoping I can return it. I just can't seem to get the hang of it.
I can certainly look into that for you. I just need to pull up your account. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF882-15-B. I think.

Thank you, Alex. One moment... Okay, I see your order right here, delivered on December 15th, so that's 17 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, it's definitely not broken or anything. It's just... it's so confusing. The app and the band... it all feels very `hard to use`. I really `expected more` from it, for it to be simpler.
I see. Did you have a chance to look through the setup guide?
I did. I read the whole `user manual`, but I'm still feeling overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I'd really prefer to just send it back if possible.
Of course, Alex. I understand completely. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you. Please hold.
Okay, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? The full 90 days? That's great! So, I can return it then?

Yes, absolutely. Since you're only on day 17, we can process a full refund for you. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just place the VeloBand back in its original packaging and attach that label.
Wow, that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Sarah. That's incredibly helpful.
You're very welcome, Alex. As soon as we receive the return at our warehouse, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for making that so easy.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
